newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 10 discount T-bill issues.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 10 discount T-bill issues.

text.p: Bulgaria's finance ministry will offer 10 issues of discount T-bills with no par value set in advance at auctions this week, the central bank said.
Half of the issues have a maturity of one week and the rest have a four-week maturity. Auction dates and issue dates for each issue overlap.
The ministry on Thursday decided to issue seven-day treasury bills every day to regulate excessive banks' liquidity in line with preparations for the introduction of a restrictive monetary regime.
As a result of the ministry's decisison the central bank said that from Monday it would suspend its daily open market operations through daily revrepo auctions with repurchase of up to two days.

The decisions were related to preparing the banking system for the introduction of a currency board system proposed by the International Monetary Fund under which central bank open market operations would be curbed, a ministry official said.
